messages:
elaine: heads up from legal: they want every evidence export to record whether it was a 'snapshot' vs 'live bundle', who requested it, the justification taxonomy id, and which routing/queue handled the job. can we make this part of the export contract?

matt: +1. We should include a small export_header in the response and persist an audit row. minimal fields: export_id, mode: snapshot|live, requester, justification_id, tenant_id, routed_queue.

sara: API suggestion: POST /v1/exports with body {evidence_id, mode, justification_id, reason_text?} and return 202 + export_id for async. sync path allowed only when size < 25MB.

vic: routing policy: any export >25MB or with mode==snapshot goes to exports-service.high-memory queue. small downloads go to fast-path. quotas applied per-tenant: daily_export_tokens and parallel_export_slots.

elaine: legal requires link metadata in the ledger: {url_ttl_seconds, manifest_digest, file_size_bytes, snapshot_marker}. do not store raw files in the ledger.

matt: implementational note: routing should prefer tenantreserved_pools, fallback to shared when reserve exhausted. add telemetry that says routed_to: reserved|shared|spillover.

sara: telemetry event names: audit.export.requested, audit.export.queued, audit.export.completed, audit.export.failed. fields: export_id, evidence_id, actor_email, tenant_id, mode, routed_to, outcome, size_bytes, justification_present(boolean).

vic: quota rules draft: - daily_export_tokens deducted by ceiling(size_mb/10) per export. - parallel_export_slots limited to 3 by default. - admin role bypass option controlled by tenant flag.

elaine: sensitive data handling: if justification_text is freeform we need retention + redaction. prefer: require justification_id enum and optional redacted_reason_hash stored for traceability. some tenants can opt into storing plaintext under longer retention.

matt: ux: console should show export status row: "Export 1234 (snapshot) — queued on high-memory — ETA 8m" and a badge if preservation required. also show "who requested" and a truncated justification label. link to full audit entry for compliance users.

sara: about presigned urls: generate server-side only after export.complete; include manifest_digest for verification. TTL default 3600s. for snapshot mode, attach evidence.snapshot_id to ledger.

vic: flow for big exports: POST -> return 202 + job id -> events: audit.export.queued -> audit.export.started -> audit.export.completed -> notifications. ensure idempotency by using idempotency-key based on (actor,evidence_id,mode,justification_id) with 10m window.

elaine: can we also include the "routing policy version" or policy_hash so we can tell exactly which routing rules handled the export for later forensics?

matt: good idea. add routing_policy_version string to telemetry + audit row. stored with export record.

dev-bot: note: add migration export_jobs table with columns: export_id, tenant_id, evidence_id, mode, routed_queue, policy_version, manifest_digest, size_bytes, status, created_by, created_at.

ops-bot: checklist: feature flag `exports_preserve_contract`, migration `create_export_jobs_table`, add RBAC `exports:request` and `exports:view_audit`, add telemetry events to event catalogue.

elaine: rollout plan: start with internal tenant, then a small set of compliance customers, monitor exports per-tenant, denied_count, average wait time, and token consumption. create dashboard: Exports > By tenant, By queue, By outcome.

vic: one more: circuit-breaker on shared pool: if queue_latency > 2m for 5min, throttle non-critical exports and surface banner in console.

matt: I'll draft the API spec and a sample response. Sara can own telemetry schema. Vic will handle routing + quotas. Elaine will confirm retention + taxonomy with legal. dev-bot: open RFC PR referencing this thread.

elaine: thanks everyone. keep comments inline on the RFC. :Raised_hands:
